lot.objective: Validate the namespace migration workflow on five low-coupling top-level utility classes.

classes.notes: Small constant holder with few references. Keep OPT_VERSION untyped while PHP 8.0 remains supported. Use it to validate aliases, shims, and constant references.
Stateless feature flag with one primary consumer and an already typed boolean return value. Preserve the WordPress filter contract.
Stateless static utility with stable array-returning methods. Update parser, processor, and validator-provider references while retaining the legacy alias.
Small utility covered by focused tests. Preserve support for both integer and floating-point byte values when adding parameter and return types.
Top-level WordPress integration utility with one main consumer. Verify the WordPress return contracts before adding array and string return types.
